oha is a tiny program that sends some load to a web application and show realtime tui inspired by [rakyll/hey](https://github.com/rakyll/hey).

This program is written in Rust and powered by [tokio](https://github.com/tokio-rs/tokio) and beautiful tui by [ratatui](https://github.com/ratatui-org/ratatui).

![demo](demo.gif)

# Installation

This program is built on stable Rust, with both `make` and `cmake` prerequisites to install via cargo.

    cargo install oha

You can optionally build oha against [native-tls](https://github.com/sfackler/rust-native-tls) instead of [rustls](https://github.com/rustls/rustls).

    cargo install --no-default-features --features native-tls oha

You can enable VSOCK support by enabling `vsock` feature.

    cargo install --features vsock oha

You can enable experimental HTTP3 support by enabling the `http3` feature. This uses the [H3](https://github.com/hyperium/h3/r) library by the developers of Hyper.
It will remain experimental as long as H3 is experimental. It currently depends on using `rustls` for TLS.

## Download pre-built binary

You can download pre-built binary from [Release page](https://github.com/hatoo/oha/releases) for each version and from [Publish workflow](https://github.com/hatoo/oha/actions/workflows/release.yml) and [Publish PGO workflow](https://github.com/hatoo/oha/actions/workflows/release-pgo.yml) for each commit.

## On Arch Linux

    pacman -S oha

## On macOS (Homebrew)

    brew install oha

## On Windows (winget)

    winget install hatoo.oha

## On Debian ([Azlux's repository](http://packages.azlux.fr/))

    echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/azlux-archive-keyring.gpg] http://packages.azlux.fr/debian/ stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/azlux.list
    sudo wget -O /usr/share/keyrings/azlux-archive-keyring.gpg https://azlux.fr/repo.gpg
    apt update
    apt install oha

## X-CMD (Linux, macOS, Windows WSL/GitBash)

You can install with [x-cmd](https://www.x-cmd.com).

```sh
x env use oha
```

## Containerized

### Official Docker image

[ghcr.io/hatoo/oha](https://github.com/hatoo/oha/pkgs/container/oha)

### Build image locally

You can also build and create a container image including oha

```sh
docker build -t hatoo/oha:latest .
```

Then you can use oha directly through the container

```sh
docker run --rm -it --network=host hatoo/oha:latest https://example.com:3000
```

## Profile-Guided Optimization (PGO)

You can build `oha` with PGO by using the following commands:

```sh
bun run pgo.js
```

And the binary will be available at `target/[target-triple]/pgo/oha`.

**Note**: Please keep in mind that in order to run the aforementioned command,
you need to have installed `cargo-pgo` cargo package.

You can install it via `cargo install cargo-pgo`.

- MacOS - Tested on iTerm2

    body_used=[('-d <BODY_STRING>',o.body_string is not None),('-D <BODY_PATH>',o.body_path is not None),('-Z <BODY_PATH_LINES>',o.body_path_lines is not None),('-F <FORM>',bool(o.forms))]
    first=None
    for name,used in body_used:
        if used and first is None: first=name
        elif used and first:
            sys.stderr.write(f"error: the argument '{first}' cannot be used with '{name}'\n\nUsage: {prog_name()} {first.split()[0]} <{first.split('<',1)[1] if '<' in first else ''} <URL>\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
            raise SystemExit(2)
    o.n=parse_int_suffix(str(o.n), '-n <N_REQUESTS>')
    o.c=max(1, parse_int_suffix(str(o.c), '-c <N_CONNECTIONS>'))
    o.p=max(1, parse_int_suffix(str(o.p), '-p <N_HTTP2_PARALLEL>'))
    o.fps=parse_int_suffix(str(o.fps), '--fps <FPS>')
    o.max_repeat=parse_int_suffix(str(o.max_repeat), '--max-repeat <MAX_REPEAT>')
    if o.dump_urls is not None: o.dump_urls=parse_int_suffix(str(o.dump_urls), '--dump-urls <DUMP_URLS>')
    o.burst_rate=parse_int_suffix(str(o.burst_rate), '--burst-rate <BURST_REQUESTS>') if o.burst_rate is not None else 1
    if o.redirect is not None: o.redirect=parse_int_suffix(str(o.redirect), '-r <REDIRECT>')
    if o.output_format not in ('text','json','csv','quiet'):
        sys.stderr.write(f"error: invalid value '{o.output_format}' for '--output-format <OUTPUT_FORMAT>'\n  [possible values: text, json, csv, quiet]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
        raise SystemExit(2)
    if o.time_unit is not None and o.time_unit not in ('ns','us','ms','s','m','h'):
        sys.stderr.write(f"error: invalid value '{o.time_unit}' for '--time-unit <TIME_UNIT>'\n  [possible values: ns, us, ms, s, m, h]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.\n")
        raise SystemExit(2)
    if o.http2: o.http_version='2'
    if o.http_version is not None and str(o.http_version) not in ('0.9','1.0','1.1','2','3'):
        sys.stderr.write('Error: Unknown HTTP version. Valid versions are 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 2, 3\n')
        raise SystemExit(1)
    if str(o.http_version) in ('2','3'):
        # We still perform ordinary HTTP/1.1; if impossible, user gets connection error. This keeps CLI usable.
        pass
    o.timeout=parse_duration(o.timeout) if o.timeout is not None else None
    o.connect_timeout=parse_duration(o.connect_timeout) if o.connect_timeout is not None else 5.0
    o.z=parse_duration(o.z) if o.z is not None else None
    o.q=float(o.q) if o.q is not None else None
    o.burst_delay=parse_duration(o.burst_delay) if o.burst_delay is not None else None
    return o

class Result:
    __slots__=('start','dns','dial','resp_delay','duration','bytes','status','error','connect_time')
    def __init__(self,start=0,dns=0,dial=0,resp_delay=0,duration=0,bytes=0,status=None,error=None,connect_time=0):
        self.start=start; self.dns=dns; self.dial=dial; self.resp_delay=resp_delay; self.duration=duration; self.bytes=bytes; self.status=status; self.error=error; self.connect_time=connect_time

class UnixHTTPConnection(http.client.HTTPConnection):
    def __init__(self, unix_socket, host='localhost', timeout=None):
        super().__init__(host, timeout=timeout); self.unix_socket=unix_socket
    def connect(self):
        self.sock=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        if self.timeout is not None: self.sock.settimeout(self.timeout)
        self.sock.connect(self.unix_socket)

def http_version_str(o):
    if str(o.http_version)=='1.0': return 'HTTP/1.0'
    if str(o.http_version)=='0.9': return 'HTTP/0.9'
    return 'HTTP/1.1'

def parse_headers(header_list):
    headers=[]
    for h in header_list:
        if ':' in h:
            k,v=h.split(':',1); headers.append((k.strip().lower(), v.strip()))
        else:
            headers.append((h.strip().lower(), ''))
    return headers

def choose_body(o, idx=0):
    if o.body_string is not None:
        return o.body_string.encode()
    if o.body_path is not None:
        with open(o.body_path,'rb') as f: return f.read()
    if o.body_path_lines is not None:
        try:
            with open(o.body_path_lines,'rb') as f: lines=f.read().splitlines()
            if not lines: return b''
            return lines[idx % len(lines)]
        except Exception:
            raise
    if o.forms:
        boundary='------------------------' + ''.join(random.choice('0123456789abcdef') for _ in range(16))
        parts=[]
        for form in o.forms:
            if '=' in form:
                name,val=form.split('=',1)
            else:
                name,val=form,''
            name=name.strip()
            if val.startswith('@'):
                path=val[1:]
                try: data=open(path,'rb').read()
                except Exception: data=b''
                filename=os.path.basename(path)
                parts.append((f'--{boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="{name}"; filename="{filename}"\r\n\r\n').encode()+data+b'\r\n')
            else:
                parts.append((f'--{boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="{name}"\r\n\r\n{val}\r\n').encode())
        parts.append((f'--{boundary}--\r\n').encode())
        o._form_boundary=boundary
        return b''.join(parts)
    return None

def build_request(o, parsed, idx=0):
    body=choose_body(o, idx)
    method=o.method.upper() if o.method else 'GET'
    if body is not None and (not o.method or o.method == 'GET'):
        # Original keeps default GET with -d? let's test not critical; common tools use POST. oha appears method stays GET? Avoid surprise? Use set method only explicit.
        pass
    headers={}
    headers['accept'] = o.accept if o.accept is not None else '*/*'
    if not o.disable_compression:
        headers['accept-encoding']='gzip, compress, deflate, br'
    headers['user-agent']='oha/1.12.1'
    if o.content_type:
        headers['content-type']=o.content_type
    if o.forms and not o.content_type:
        headers['content-type']='multipart/form-data; boundary=' + getattr(o,'_form_boundary','')
    host=o.host if o.host else parsed.netloc
    if host: headers['host']=host
    if o.basic_auth:
        token=base64.b64encode(o.basic_auth.encode()).decode()
        headers['authorization']='Basic '+token
    if o.aws_session:
        headers['x-amz-security-token']=o.aws_session
    for k,v in parse_headers(o.headers):
        headers[k]=v
    if o.disable_keepalive:
        headers['connection']='close'
    path=parsed.path or '/'
    if parsed.params: path += ';'+parsed.params
    if parsed.query: path += '?'+parsed.query
    return method, path, headers, body

def make_connection(o, parsed, timeout):
    scheme=parsed.scheme.lower()
    host=parsed.hostname; port=parsed.port
    if o.unix_socket:
        return UnixHTTPConnection(o.unix_socket, host=host or 'localhost', timeout=timeout), 0.0, 0.0
    # connect-to support: host:port:target_host:target_port
    target_host=host; target_port=port
    default_port=443 if scheme=='https' else 80
    if target_port is None: target_port=default_port
    if o.connect_to:
        candidates=[]
        hp=f"{host}:{target_port}"
        for item in o.connect_to:
            parts=item.split(':')
            if len(parts)==4 and parts[0]==host and int(parts[1] or default_port)==target_port:
                candidates.append((parts[2], int(parts[3])))
        if candidates:
            target_host,target_port=random.choice(candidates)
    if o.proxy and scheme == 'http':
        pp=urllib.parse.urlparse(o.proxy if '://' in o.proxy else 'http://'+o.proxy)
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection(pp.hostname, pp.port or 80, timeout=timeout)
    elif scheme == 'https':
        ctx=None
        if o.insecure:
            ctx=ssl._create_unverified_context()
        elif o.cacert:
            ctx=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=o.cacert)
        if ctx and o.cert and o.key:
            try: ctx.load_cert_chain(o.cert,o.key)
            except Exception: pass
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection(target_host, target_port, timeout=timeout, context=ctx)
    else:
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection(target_host, target_port, timeout=timeout)
    return conn, 0.0, 0.0

def map_error(e):
    if isinstance(e, socket.timeout) or 'timed out' in str(e).lower() or 'timeout' in str(e).lower():
        return 'timeout'
    s=str(e)
    if isinstance(e, ConnectionRefusedError):
        return 'Connection refused (os error 111)'
    if 'Connection refused' in s:
        return 'Connection refused (os error 111)'
    if 'Name or service not known' in s:
        return 'failed to lookup address information: Name or service not known'
    if 'No address associated' in s:
        return 'failed to lookup address information: No address associated with hostname'
    return s or e.__class__.__name__

def request_once(o, url, idx=0, base_start=None):
    if base_start is None: base_start=time.monotonic()
    start_rel=time.monotonic()-base_start
    parsed=urllib.parse.urlparse(url)
    timeout=o.timeout if o.timeout is not None else None
    if timeout is None: timeout=o.connect_timeout
    if parsed.scheme.lower() not in ('http','https') and not o.unix_socket:
        # mimic the observed behavior for unsupported schemes: it times out eventually. Do not actually wait forever.
        time.sleep(min(timeout or 0.01, 0.05))
        return Result(start_rel, duration=0, error='timeout')
    req_start=time.perf_counter()
    conn=None; dns=0.0; dial=0.0
    try:
        cstart=time.perf_counter(); conn,dns,dial=make_connection(o, parsed, timeout); conn_t=time.perf_counter()-cstart
        method,path,headers,body=build_request(o, parsed, idx)
        request_target=path
        if o.proxy and parsed.scheme.lower()=='http':
            request_target=url
        send_start=time.perf_counter()
        # Preserve casing? HTTPConnection normalizes Host if skip_host false. We set skip_host/accept_encoding to avoid duplicates.
        conn.putrequest(method, request_target, skip_host=True, skip_accept_encoding=True)
        for k,v in headers.items():
            conn.putheader(k, v)
        if body is not None:
            conn.putheader('content-length', str(len(body)))
        conn.endheaders()
        if body is not None: conn.send(body)
        resp_start=time.perf_counter()
        resp=conn.getresponse()
        resp_delay=time.perf_counter()-resp_start
        data=resp.read()
        dur=time.perf_counter()-req_start
        status=resp.status
        # redirect handling; measure cumulative duration and final body/status
        redirects=0; cur_url=url
        while status in (301,302,303,307,308) and redirects < (o.redirect or 0):
            loc=resp.getheader('location')
            try: conn.close()
            except: pass
            if not loc: break
            cur_url=urllib.parse.urljoin(cur_url, loc)
            parsed=urllib.parse.urlparse(cur_url)
            conn,_,_=make_connection(o, parsed, timeout)
            method2=method
            body2=body
            if status in (301,302,303) and method not in ('GET','HEAD'):
                method2='GET'; body2=None
            methodx,pathx,headersx,bodyx=build_request(o, parsed, idx)
            methodx=method2; bodyx=body2
            conn.putrequest(methodx, pathx, skip_host=True, skip_accept_encoding=True)
            for k,v in headersx.items(): conn.putheader(k,v)
            if bodyx is not None: conn.putheader('content-length', str(len(bodyx)))
            conn.endheaders();
            if bodyx is not None: conn.send(bodyx)
            resp=conn.getresponse(); data=resp.read(); status=resp.status
            redirects += 1
        dur=time.perf_counter()-req_start
        try: conn.close()
        except: pass
        return Result(start_rel, dns=dns, dial=conn_t, resp_delay=resp_delay, duration=dur, bytes=len(data), status=status, error=None, connect_time=conn_t)
    except Exception as e:
        try:
            if conn: conn.close()
        except Exception: pass
        return Result(start_rel, dns=dns, dial=dial, duration=0, error=map_error(e))

def load_urls(o):
    if o.urls_from_file:
        try:
            with open(o.url,'r',encoding='utf-8') as f:
                urls=[line.strip() for line in f if line.strip()]
            return urls or [o.url]
        except Exception as e:
            sys.stderr.write('Error: '+str(e)+'\n'); raise SystemExit(1)
    return [o.url]

def gen_regex_url(pattern, max_repeat=4):
    # Lightweight generator for common rand-regex examples. It intentionally avoids dot as documented.
    out=[]; i=0
    while i < len(pattern):
        c=pattern[i]
        if c == '[':
            j=pattern.find(']',i+1)
            if j!=-1:
                spec=pattern[i+1:j]; choices=[]; k=0
                while k < len(spec):
                    if k+2 < len(spec) and spec[k+1]=='-':
                        choices += [chr(x) for x in range(ord(spec[k]), ord(spec[k+2])+1)]
                        k+=3
                    else:
                        choices.append(spec[k]); k+=1
                out.append(random.choice(choices or ['']))
                i=j+1; continue
        if c == '.': out.append(random.choice('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'))
        elif c == '\\' and i+1 < len(pattern): out.append(pattern[i+1]); i+=1
        elif c in '*+?': pass
        else: out.append(c)
        i+=1
    return ''.join(out)

def run_load(o):
    urls=load_urls(o)
    if o.dump_urls is not None:
        for i in range(o.dump_urls):
            print(gen_regex_url(o.url, o.max_repeat) if o.rand_regex_url else urls[i % len(urls)])
        return [], 0.0
    # validate URL-ish first like url crate for common bad case
    if not o.rand_regex_url:
        p=urllib.parse.urlparse(urls[0])
        if not p.scheme:
            sys.stderr.write('Error: relative URL without a base\n'); raise SystemExit(1)
    n=o.n
    if o.z is not None and ('-n' not in sys.argv[1:]):
        # original still has a maximum, but duration mode conceptually runs until deadline. Cap to keep safe.
        n=10**9
    results=[]; lock=threading.Lock(); next_id=0; stop=False
    start=time.monotonic()
    deadline=start+o.z if o.z is not None else None
    qps=o.q
    csv_mode=(o.output_format=='csv')
    def get_job():
        nonlocal next_id, stop
        with lock:
            if stop: return None
            now=time.monotonic()
            if deadline is not None and now >= deadline:
                stop=True; return None
            if next_id >= n:
                stop=True; return None
            idx=next_id; next_id+=1
        if qps and qps>0:
            target=start + idx/float(qps)
            delay=target-time.monotonic()
            if delay>0: time.sleep(delay)
        elif o.burst_delay and o.burst_rate and idx>0 and idx % o.burst_rate == 0:
            time.sleep(o.burst_delay)
        return idx
    def worker():
        while True:
            idx=get_job()
            if idx is None: break
            url=gen_regex_url(o.url,o.max_repeat) if o.rand_regex_url else urls[idx % len(urls)]
            r=request_once(o,url,idx,base_start=start)
            with lock: results.append(r)
    threads=[]
    count=max(1, min(o.c * (o.p if str(o.http_version)=='2' else 1), 512))
    for _ in range(count):
        t=threading.Thread(target=worker); t.daemon=True; t.start(); threads.append(t)
    for t in threads: t.join()
    total=max(0.0, time.monotonic()-start)
    # sqlite output basic support
    if o.db_url:
        try:
            import sqlite3
            con=sqlite3.connect(o.db_url)
            con.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS result (request_start REAL, dns REAL, dns_dialup REAL, response_delay REAL, request_duration REAL, bytes INTEGER, status INTEGER)')
            for r in results:
                if r.error is None:
                    con.execute('INSERT INTO result VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(r.start,r.dns,r.dial,r.resp_delay,r.duration,r.bytes,r.status))
            con.commit(); con.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
    results.sort(key=lambda r: r.start)
    return results,total

def percentile(vals, p):
    if not vals: return math.nan
    vals=sorted(vals)
    if len(vals)==1: return vals[0]
    # Observed behavior is close to nearest-rank rounded up for small samples.
    idx=math.ceil(p/100.0*len(vals))-1
    idx=max(0,min(len(vals)-1,idx))
    return vals[idx]

UNIT_SCALE={'ns':(1e9,'ns'),'us':(1e6,'us'),'ms':(1e3,'ms'),'s':(1,'sec'),'m':(1/60,'min'),'h':(1/3600,'hr')}
def choose_unit(seconds, forced=None):
    if forced: return UNIT_SCALE[forced]
    if seconds <= 0 or math.isnan(seconds) or math.isinf(seconds): return (1e9,'ns')
    if seconds < 1e-6: return (1e9,'ns')
    if seconds < 1e-3: return (1e6,'us')
    if seconds < 1: return (1e3,'ms')
    if seconds < 60: return (1,'sec')
    if seconds < 3600: return (1/60,'min')
    return (1/3600,'hr')

def fmt_time(x, scale, label, digits=4):
    if math.isnan(x): return f"NaN {label}"
    if math.isinf(x): return ("inf" if x>0 else "-inf") + f" {label}"
    return f"{x*scale:.{digits}f} {label}"

def fmt_time_hist(x, scale, label):
    if math.isnan(x): return f"NaN {label}"
    if math.isinf(x): return ("inf" if x>0 else "-inf") + f" {label}"
    return f"{x*scale:.3f} {label}"

def fmt_bytes(n):
    try: n=float(n)
    except: return 'NaN'
    if math.isnan(n): return 'NaN'
    units=['B','KiB','MiB','GiB','TiB']
    i=0
    while abs(n) >= 1024 and i < len(units)-1:
        n/=1024.0; i+=1
    if i==0:
        return f"{int(round(n))} B"
    return f"{n:.2f} {units[i]}"

def histogram(vals):
    if not vals: return [(math.nan,0)]*11
    mn=min(vals); mx=max(vals)
    if mx==mn:
        return [(mn, len(vals) if i==0 else 0) for i in range(11)]
    step=(mx-mn)/10.0
    buckets=[]
    for i in range(11):
        edge=mn+step*i
        if i==0: count=sum(1 for v in vals if v <= edge+1e-15)
        elif i==10: count=sum(1 for v in vals if v > mn+step*(i-1)-1e-15 and v <= edge+1e-12)
        else: count=sum(1 for v in vals if v > mn+step*(i-1)-1e-15 and v <= edge+1e-15)
        buckets.append((edge,count))
    return buckets

def summary_stats(results,total):
    successes=[r for r in results if r.error is None]
    vals=[r.duration for r in successes]
    n=len(results); ok=len(successes)
    total_data=sum(r.bytes for r in successes)
    return {
        'n':n,'ok':ok,'success_rate':(ok/n if n else 0.0),'total':total,
        'slowest':max(vals) if vals else -math.inf,
        'fastest':min(vals) if vals else math.inf,
        'average':(sum(vals)/len(vals) if vals else math.nan),
        'rps':(n/total if total>0 else math.inf),
        'total_data':total_data,
        'size_per_req':(total_data/ok if ok else math.nan),
        'size_per_sec':(total_data/total if total>0 else 0),
        'vals': vals,
        'dns_vals':[r.dns for r in successes if r.dns>0],
        'dial_vals':[r.dial for r in successes if r.dial>0],
        'successes':successes,
    }

def render_hist_and_dist(vals, scale, label, title_suffix=''):
    out=[]; buckets=histogram(vals); maxc=max([c for _,c in buckets] or [0])
    out.append(f"Response time histogram{title_suffix}:")
    for edge,count in buckets:
        bar='■'*(0 if maxc==0 else int(round(count/maxc*32)))
        out.append(f"  {fmt_time_hist(edge,scale,label):>12} [{count}] |{bar}")
    out.append('')
    out.append(f"Response time distribution{title_suffix}:")
    for p,ps in [(10,'10.00'),(25,'25.00'),(50,'50.00'),(75,'75.00'),(90,'90.00'),(95,'95.00'),(99,'99.00'),(99.9,'99.90'),(99.99,'99.99')]:
        out.append(f"  {ps}% in {fmt_time(percentile(vals,p),scale,label)}")
    out.append('')
    return out

def render_text(results,total,o):

    out=[]

                except Exception: data=b''
                filename=os.path.basename(path)
                parts.append((f'--{boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="{name}"; filename="{filename}"\r\n\r\n').encode()+data+b'\r\n')
            else:
                parts.append((f'--{boundary}\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="{name}"\r\n\r\n{val}\r\n').encode())
        parts.append((f'--{boundary}--\r\n').encode())
        o._form_boundary=boundary
        return b''.join(parts)
    return None

def build_request(o, parsed, idx=0):
    body=choose_body(o, idx)
    method=o.method.upper() if o.method else 'GET'
    if body is not None and (not o.method or o.method == 'GET'):
        # Original keeps default GET with -d? let's test not critical; common tools use POST. oha appears method stays GET? Avoid surprise? Use set method only explicit.
        pass
    headers={}
    headers['accept'] = o.accept if o.accept is not None else '*/*'
    if not o.disable_compression:
        headers['accept-encoding']='gzip, compress, deflate, br'
    headers['user-agent']='oha/1.12.1'
    if o.content_type:
        headers['content-type']=o.content_type
    if o.forms and not o.content_type:
        headers['content-type']='multipart/form-data; boundary=' + getattr(o,'_form_boundary','')
    host=o.host if o.host else parsed.netloc
    if host: headers['host']=host
    if o.basic_auth:
        token=base64.b64encode(o.basic_auth.encode()).decode()
        headers['authorization']='Basic '+token
    if o.aws_session:
        headers['x-amz-security-token']=o.aws_session
    for k,v in parse_headers(o.headers):
        headers[k]=v
    if o.disable_keepalive:
        headers['connection']='close'
    path=parsed.path or '/'
    if parsed.params: path += ';'+parsed.params
    if parsed.query: path += '?'+parsed.query
    return method, path, headers, body

def make_connection(o, parsed, timeout):
    scheme=parsed.scheme.lower()
    host=parsed.hostname; port=parsed.port
    if o.unix_socket:
        return UnixHTTPConnection(o.unix_socket, host=host or 'localhost', timeout=timeout), 0.0, 0.0
    # connect-to support: host:port:target_host:target_port
    target_host=host; target_port=port
    default_port=443 if scheme=='https' else 80
    if target_port is None: target_port=default_port
    if o.connect_to:
        candidates=[]
        hp=f"{host}:{target_port}"
        for item in o.connect_to:
            parts=item.split(':')
            if len(parts)==4 and parts[0]==host and int(parts[1] or default_port)==target_port:
                candidates.append((parts[2], int(parts[3])))
        if candidates:
            target_host,target_port=random.choice(candidates)
    if o.proxy and scheme == 'http':
        pp=urllib.parse.urlparse(o.proxy if '://' in o.proxy else 'http://'+o.proxy)
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection(pp.hostname, pp.port or 80, timeout=timeout)
    elif scheme == 'https':
        ctx=None
        if o.insecure:
            ctx=ssl._create_unverified_context()
        elif o.cacert:
            ctx=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=o.cacert)
        if ctx and o.cert and o.key:
            try: ctx.load_cert_chain(o.cert,o.key)
            except Exception: pass
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection(target_host, target_port, timeout=timeout, context=ctx)
    else:
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection(target_host, target_port, timeout=timeout)
    return conn, 0.0, 0.0

def map_error(e):
    if isinstance(e, socket.timeout) or 'timed out' in str(e).lower() or 'timeout' in str(e).lower():
        return 'timeout'
    s=str(e)
    if isinstance(e, ConnectionRefusedError):
        return 'Connection refused (os error 111)'
    if 'Connection refused' in s:
        return 'Connection refused (os error 111)'
    if 'Name or service not known' in s:
        return 'failed to lookup address information: Name or service not known'
    if 'No address associated' in s:
        return 'failed to lookup address information: No address associated with hostname'
    return s or e.__class__.__name__

def request_once(o, url, idx=0, base_start=None):
    if base_start is None: base_start=time.monotonic()
    start_rel=time.monotonic()-base_start
    parsed=urllib.parse.urlparse(url)
    timeout=o.timeout if o.timeout is not None else None
    if timeout is None: timeout=o.connect_timeout
    if parsed.scheme.lower() not in ('http','https') and not o.unix_socket:
        # mimic the observed behavior for unsupported schemes: it times out eventually. Do not actually wait forever.
        time.sleep(min(timeout or 0.01, 0.05))
        return Result(start_rel, duration=0, error='timeout')
    req_start=time.perf_counter()
    conn=None; dns=0.0; dial=0.0
    try:
        cstart=time.perf_counter(); conn,dns,dial=make_connection(o, parsed, timeout); conn_t=time.perf_counter()-cstart
        method,path,headers,body=build_request(o, parsed, idx)
        request_target=path
        if o.proxy and parsed.scheme.lower()=='http':
            request_target=url
        send_start=time.perf_counter()
        # Preserve casing? HTTPConnection normalizes Host if skip_host false. We set skip_host/accept_encoding to avoid duplicates.
        conn.putrequest(method, request_target, skip_host=True, skip_accept_encoding=True)
        for k,v in headers.items():
            conn.putheader(k, v)
        if body is not None:
            conn.putheader('content-length', str(len(body)))
        conn.endheaders()
        if body is not None: conn.send(body)
        resp_start=time.perf_counter()
        resp=conn.getresponse()
        resp_delay=time.perf_counter()-resp_start
        data=resp.read()
        dur=time.perf_counter()-req_start
        status=resp.status
        # redirect handling; measure cumulative duration and final body/status
        redirects=0; cur_url=url
        while status in (301,302,303,307,308) and redirects < (o.redirect or 0):
            loc=resp.getheader('location')
            try: conn.close()
            except: pass
            if not loc: break
            cur_url=urllib.parse.urljoin(cur_url, loc)
            parsed=urllib.parse.urlparse(cur_url)
            conn,_,_=make_connection(o, parsed, timeout)
            method2=method
            body2=body
            if status in (301,302,303) and method not in ('GET','HEAD'):
                method2='GET'; body2=None
            methodx,pathx,headersx,bodyx=build_request(o, parsed, idx)
            methodx=method2; bodyx=body2
            conn.putrequest(methodx, pathx, skip_host=True, skip_accept_encoding=True)
            for k,v in headersx.items(): conn.putheader(k,v)
            if bodyx is not None: conn.putheader('content-length', str(len(bodyx)))
            conn.endheaders();
            if bodyx is not None: conn.send(bodyx)
            resp=conn.getresponse(); data=resp.read(); status=resp.status
            redirects += 1
        dur=time.perf_counter()-req_start
        try: conn.close()
        except: pass
        return Result(start_rel, dns=dns, dial=conn_t, resp_delay=resp_delay, duration=dur, bytes=len(data), status=status, error=None, connect_time=conn_t)
    except Exception as e:
        try:
            if conn: conn.close()
        except Exception: pass
        return Result(start_rel, dns=dns, dial=dial, duration=0, error=map_error(e))

def load_urls(o):

        try:
            with open(o.url,'r',encoding='utf-8') as f:
                urls=[line.strip() for line in f if line.strip()]
            return urls or [o.url]
        except Exception as e:

    return [o.url]

def gen_regex_url(pattern, max_repeat=4):
    # Lightweight generator for common rand-regex examples. It intentionally avoids dot as documented.
    out=[]; i=0
    while i < len(pattern):
        c=pattern[i]
        if c == '[':
            j=pattern.find(']',i+1)
            if j!=-1:
                spec=pattern[i+1:j]; choices=[]; k=0
                while k < len(spec):
                    if k+2 < len(spec) and spec[k+1]=='-':
                        choices += [chr(x) for x in range(ord(spec[k]), ord(spec[k+2])+1)]
                        k+=3
                    else:
                        choices.append(spec[k]); k+=1
                out.append(random.choice(choices or ['']))
                i=j+1; continue
        if c == '.': out.append(random.choice('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'))
        elif c == '\\' and i+1 < len(pattern): out.append(pattern[i+1]); i+=1
        elif c in '*+?': pass
        else: out.append(c)
        i+=1
    return ''.join(out)

def run_load(o):
    urls=load_urls(o)
    if o.dump_urls is not None:
        for i in range(o.dump_urls):
            print(gen_regex_url(o.url, o.max_repeat) if o.rand_regex_url else urls[i % len(urls)])
        return [], 0.0
    # validate URL-ish first like url crate for common bad case
    if not o.rand_regex_url:
        p=urllib.parse.urlparse(urls[0])
        if not p.scheme:
            sys.stderr.write('Error: relative URL without a base\n'); raise SystemExit(1)
    n=o.n
    if o.z is not None and ('-n' not in sys.argv[1:]):
        # original still has a maximum, but duration mode conceptually runs until deadline. Cap to keep safe.
        n=10**9
    results=[]; lock=threading.Lock(); next_id=0; stop=False
    start=time.monotonic()
    deadline=start+o.z if o.z is not None else None
    qps=o.q
    csv_mode=(o.output_format=='csv')
    def get_job():
        nonlocal next_id, stop
        with lock:
            if stop: return None
            now=time.monotonic()
            if deadline is not None and now >= deadline:
                stop=True; return None
            if next_id >= n:
                stop=True; return None
            idx=next_id; next_id+=1
        if qps and qps>0:
            target=start + idx/float(qps)
            delay=target-time.monotonic()
            if delay>0: time.sleep(delay)
        elif o.burst_delay and o.burst_rate and idx>0 and idx % o.burst_rate == 0:
            time.sleep(o.burst_delay)
        return idx
    def worker():
        while True:
            idx=get_job()
            if idx is None: break
            url=gen_regex_url(o.url,o.max_repeat) if o.rand_regex_url else urls[idx % len(urls)]
            r=request_once(o,url,idx,base_start=start)
            with lock: results.append(r)
    threads=[]
    count=max(1, min(o.c * (o.p if str(o.http_version)=='2' else 1), 512))
    for _ in range(count):
        t=threading.Thread(target=worker); t.daemon=True; t.start(); threads.append(t)
    for t in threads: t.join()
    total=max(0.0, time.monotonic()-start)
    # sqlite output basic support
    if o.db_url:
        try:
            import sqlite3
            con=sqlite3.connect(o.db_url)
            con.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS result (request_start REAL, dns REAL, dns_dialup REAL, response_delay REAL, request_duration REAL, bytes INTEGER, status INTEGER)')
            for r in results:
                if r.error is None:
                    con.execute('INSERT INTO result VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',(r.start,r.dns,r.dial,r.resp_delay,r.duration,r.bytes,r.status))
            con.commit(); con.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
    results.sort(key=lambda r: r.start)
    return results,total

def percentile(vals, p):
    if not vals: return math.nan
    vals=sorted(vals)
    if len(vals)==1: return vals[0]
    # Observed behavior is close to nearest-rank rounded up for small samples.
    idx=math.ceil(p/100.0*len(vals))-1
    idx=max(0,min(len(vals)-1,idx))
    return vals[idx]

UNIT_SCALE={'ns':(1e9,'ns'),'us':(1e6,'us'),'ms':(1e3,'ms'),'s':(1,'sec'),'m':(1/60,'min'),'h':(1/3600,'hr')}
def choose_unit(seconds, forced=None):
    if forced: return UNIT_SCALE[forced]
    if seconds <= 0 or math.isnan(seconds) or math.isinf(seconds): return (1e9,'ns')
    if seconds < 1e-6: return (1e9,'ns')
    if seconds < 1e-3: return (1e6,'us')
    if seconds < 1: return (1e3,'ms')
    if seconds < 60: return (1,'sec')
    if seconds < 3600: return (1/60,'min')
    return (1/3600,'hr')

def fmt_time(x, scale, label, digits=4):
    if math.isnan(x): return f"NaN {label}"
    if math.isinf(x): return ("inf" if x>0 else "-inf") + f" {label}"
    return f"{x*scale:.{digits}f} {label}"

def fmt_time_hist(x, scale, label):
    if math.isnan(x): return f"NaN {label}"
    if math.isinf(x): return ("inf" if x>0 else "-inf") + f" {label}"
    return f"{x*scale:.3f} {label}"

def fmt_bytes(n):
    try: n=float(n)
    except: return 'NaN'
    if math.isnan(n): return 'NaN'
    units=['B','KiB','MiB','GiB','TiB']
    i=0
    while abs(n) >= 1024 and i < len(units)-1:
        n/=1024.0; i+=1
    if i==0:
        return f"{int(round(n))} B"
    return f"{n:.2f} {units[i]}"

def histogram(vals):
    if not vals: return [(math.nan,0)]*11
    mn=min(vals); mx=max(vals)
    if mx==mn:
        return [(mn, len(vals) if i==0 else 0) for i in range(11)]
    step=(mx-mn)/10.0
    buckets=[]
    for i in range(11):
        edge=mn+step*i
        if i==0: count=sum(1 for v in vals if v <= edge+1e-15)
        elif i==10: count=sum(1 for v in vals if v > mn+step*(i-1)-1e-15 and v <= edge+1e-12)
        else: count=sum(1 for v in vals if v > mn+step*(i-1)-1e-15 and v <= edge+1e-15)
        buckets.append((edge,count))
    return buckets

def summary_stats(results,total):
    successes=[r for r in results if r.error is None]
    vals=[r.duration for r in successes]
    n=len(results); ok=len(successes)
    total_data=sum(r.bytes for r in successes)
    return {
        'n':n,'ok':ok,'success_rate':(ok/n if n else 0.0),'total':total,
        'slowest':max(vals) if vals else -math.inf,
        'fastest':min(vals) if vals else math.inf,
        'average':(sum(vals)/len(vals) if vals else math.nan),
        'rps':(n/total if total>0 else math.inf),
        'total_data':total_data,
        'size_per_req':(total_data/ok if ok else math.nan),
        'size_per_sec':(total_data/total if total>0 else 0),
        'vals': vals,
        'dns_vals':[r.dns for r in successes if r.dns>0],
        'dial_vals':[r.dial for r in successes if r.dial>0],
        'successes':successes,
    }

def render_hist_and_dist(vals, scale, label, title_suffix=''):
    out=[]; buckets=histogram(vals); maxc=max([c for _,c in buckets] or [0])
    out.append(f"Response time histogram{title_suffix}:")
    for edge,count in buckets:
        bar='■'*(0 if maxc==0 else int(round(count/maxc*32)))
        out.append(f"  {fmt_time_hist(edge,scale,label):>12} [{count}] |{bar}")
    out.append('')
    out.append(f"Response time distribution{title_suffix}:")
    for p,ps in [(10,'10.00'),(25,'25.00'),(50,'50.00'),(75,'75.00'),(90,'90.00'),(95,'95.00'),(99,'99.00'),(99.9,'99.90'),(99.99,'99.99')]:
        out.append(f"  {ps}% in {fmt_time(percentile(vals,p),scale,label)}")
    out.append('')
    return out

def render_json(results,total,o):

        rps={'mean':mean,'stddev':math.sqrt(var),'max':max(rv),'min':min(rv),'percentiles':{k:percentile(rv,p) for k,p in [('p10',10),('p25',25),('p50',50),('p75',75),('p90',90),('p95',95),('p99',99),('p99.9',99.9),('p99.99',99.99)]}}

    dial=st['dial_vals']; dns=st['dns_vals']
